schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).

main.note: an unused label in front of progname = *argv++ (the original reads argv from its home there, as codgen does behind a label); the usage message is an initialised array usage[] (one string for its five uses).

doit.note: names guessed. An open error path returns without closing the chkfile (cannot create lockfile).

putline.note: if (!eflag) keyword(...); else wfprintf(...): the keyword() block first (masked equal with ccv0 of 2026-11-23). The frame has 2 bytes more than the parameters: an unused local. line = line + 1 (not line++: ld/inc/ld).

wfprintf.note: open: the original copies the three stack arguments through r0, ours through r2 (r2 holds the sixth parameter; ccv0 takes it as a scratch and reloads it). ferror(fp) != 0 gives the tcc of the original.

readchk.note: if (rel && (rel == r && lev == l)) (the form chkin needs, the same code here). The long through r2 into rr2: OLD_D2Q, since 2026-11-23 in v0 too (host/OLDCC.md, D2).

apply.note: nested if (cmd != *) if (curline >= n1) switch, else putline twice (the form chkin needs; ccv0 lays it out as the original too); the cases in the order a, d, c.

nextcmd.note: if (*p != a && != d && != c) { error } else vp->cmd = *p++; then while loops: the layout of the original (popt moves the block behind the first loop in front of it).

getat.note: fseek(in, vp->pos, 0): ldl rr4,4(r4), the long into the pair of its address register whose odd half r5 holds the parameter line no longer used: OLD_D2QI (v0).

setnames.note: open: &chkname[n + 1] - p: the original ld r2,#chkname+1; add r2,n, ours ld r2,n; add r2,#chkname+1 (17 forms tried). The same source in chkin (common.c 1.3, cc) gives the order of ours there: a trait of the compiler of 07/82, not of the source. outname gets basename(chkname) as an argument (no variable; the 6(r15) of the original is the temporary).

keyword.note: a goto loop (loop/next/test): a keyword skips 3 characters straight to the test, the others share the print of %c and p++; the while and for forms are laid out otherwise by popt.

note: a WEGA program (qcv(5)) without a System III source, written from the disassembly (chkout.c, common.c, chkout.h); ccv0, the stdio.h of oldv7 and libc-v1.a (with rewind, fdopen 0_2, getpwuid 0_2, getpwent 0_2, fgets 0_2, ctime 0_2 and getenv in front of atoi). Not yet identical: putline, wfprintf (chkout.c), setnames (common.c).
